intro.text: A Malwish device for capturing shades; a shade drawn inside becomes glowing white smoke.
A Malwish device for capturing shades: a metal box of equipment small enough to hold in one hand, which turns a shade into glowing white smoke, apparently painfully.

description.text: Switching one on takes a great deal of power, though a single Jagged Star gunship can supply enough. The Malwish Planetary Guard keeps a number of them.
They are thought less effective than a Rosharan device that does a similar job, since they lean more on electronics than on Investiture.

items.text: Malwish soldiers staged an execution of Leonore to lure the shade Nazh into the open, then drew him into a shade prison, where he turned into glowing white smoke.
